actions.reason: K2_C0001 has a coherent biological phenotype (BAP1 enrichment, VHL depletion, and distinct RNA pathways), but its membership is broadly unsupported across native geometries: CT and WSI show strongly negative mean silhouettes (-0.036 and -0.083) with high negative fractions (72.7% and 78.2%), and WXS is negative (-0.069). The pair boundary is weakly represented (silhouettes 0.013–0.091, high negative fractions) and structurally merge-compatible (union eigengap k=1, normalized cut 0.773). Significant technical associations (tissue source site, CT phase, scanner model, slice thickness, z-spacing) remain plausible alternative explanations. No internal subdivision is supported. Given the weak membership, weak boundary, and unresolved confounders, the candidate lacks sufficient defensible discovery value, and no remaining evidence could reasonably rescue it.

K2_C0002 has a coherent biological phenotype (PBRM1/VHL enrichment, BAP1 depletion, and reciprocal RNA pathways), but its membership representation is inconsistent across modalities: WSI and WXS show moderate support (silhouettes 0.204 and 0.275), while CT and RNA are weak (0.069 and 0.096). The pair boundary is weakly represented and structurally merge-compatible (union eigengap k=1, normalized cut 0.773). Significant technical associations (tissue source site, CT phase, scanner model, slice thickness, z-spacing) remain plausible alternative explanations. No internal subdivision is supported. Given the weak boundary, unresolved confounders, and lack of independent structural support, the candidate lacks sufficient defensible discovery value, and no remaining evidence could reasonably rescue it.
